question: On what authority does the speaker claim to have told the practice of the soul to the one addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: A practice concerning the soul is in question.
That practice has been told to the addressee.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The source of the teaching is not stated in this verse
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
